title: 第15章 反内卷第16章 走私重甲
slug: 西游平账大圣在我贪亿点咋了
content_zh:
苏元与墨麒麟早已换好了一身黑袍。
两排同样装束的黑袍人静立两侧，
飞舟稳稳停靠后，黑袍人蚁附而上，无声地开始作业，
卸货的卸货，登记的登记，一切井然有序，效率极高。
苏元目光扫过，问道。
“尊者，这些都是你的人？这些人确实可靠么？”
墨麒麟累得直吐舌头，连着喘了好几口大气，这才嗤笑道。
“都是我的人那才叫不可靠。
告诉你，在座的各位都是这黑市的股东，背后说不定是哪路大神，水深着呢！
你以为这么大一批烫手山芋，光凭我自己能吃得下？”
苏元闻言，微微颔首。
天下最牢靠的关系，莫过于利益捆绑。
就拿自己来说，自与墨麒麟踏上同一条船，各取所需，这位尊者对自己倒没有了最初的倨傲，渐渐平起平坐起来。
货物清点完毕，众人转入密室。
刚一落座，赞叹奉承之声便此起彼伏。
“上午招抚组才清点出库的东西，晚上就到了二位手上，这手段……”
“在下佩服！
这才是手眼通天的高人啊！”
“要不是我知道太白此刻正在清微天禹余宫叙话论道，我都要怀疑是不是那老儿自己监守自盗了！”
墨麒麟抬手压下议论，用提前商量好的话术道。

“闲话少说。
这批货，我们有三个规矩。”
“第一，货怎么分，分给谁，分什么，由我们统一安排，谁也别想挑肥拣瘦。”
“第二，所有货，只准在黑市出！
每年出多少，出什么，我会给你们清单，谁敢私自倾销，坏了大局，别怪我不讲情面。”
“第三，”
他顿了顿，加重语气，“这批货的所有销售额，我们抽五成。”
话音刚落，密室內顿时像炸开的油锅。
“五成？！
你们怎么不去抢！”
“现在黑市本来就不赚钱，你们还抽五成！”
“凭什么要拖两千年？”
“胃口这么大，也不怕撑死？信不信我现在就去雷部举报！”
content_en:
Su Yuan and Mo Qilin had already changed into black robes.
Two rows of similarly dressed men in black robes stood silently on both sides.
After the flying boat docked safely, the black-robed man ants followed and started working silently.
Unloading, unloading, registration, everything is in order and very efficient.
Su Yuan glanced over and asked.
"Honorable Sir, are these your people? Are these people really reliable?"
Mo Qilin was so tired that he stuck out his tongue, took several breaths, and then sneered.
“That’s why they are unreliable if they are all mine.
Let me tell you, everyone here is a shareholder of this black market, and there may be some great master behind it. The water is deep!
Do you think I can eat such a large batch of hot potatoes by myself? "
Su Yuan nodded slightly when he heard this.
The most reliable relationship in the world is the binding of interests.
Take himself as an example. Since he and Mo Qilin stepped on the same boat and each took what he wanted, this venerable man lost his initial arrogance towards himself and gradually became an equal.
After the inventory of the goods was completed, everyone moved into the secret room.
As soon as I sat down, the voices of admiration and flattery started to rise one after another.
"In the morning, the recruitment team counted the things that came out of the warehouse, and in the evening they were in your hands. This method..."
"I admire you!
This is a master whose hands and eyes can reach the sky! "
"If I hadn't known that Taibai was conversing in Tianyu Yu Palace in Qingwei at this moment, I would have suspected that the old man was guarding and stealing by himself!"
Mo Qilin raised his hand to suppress the discussion and spoke in the words discussed in advance.
"Don't talk nonsense.
We have three rules for this batch of goods. "
"First, how to distribute the goods, to whom, and what to distribute are all arranged by us. No one can be picky."
“Second, all goods are only allowed to be sold on the black market!
I will give you a list of how much and what you will produce every year. If anyone dares to dump it privately and ruin the overall situation, don't blame me for being unkind. "
"Third,"
He paused and emphasized, "We will take 50% of all sales of this batch of goods."
As soon as he finished speaking, the secret room suddenly felt like an exploding oil pan.
"Fifty percent?!
Why don't you go grab it! "
"Now the black market is not profitable to begin with, but you still take 50%!"
"Why should it be delayed for two thousand years?"
"You have such a big appetite and you're not afraid of dying? Believe it or not, I'm going to report it to the Ministry of Mines right now!"
